description: In ESA SNAP Desktop, a Landsat multi-spectral GeoTIFF is already loaded in the Product Explorer. This file contains 4 bands (SWIR1, NIR, Red, Green). Create a false-color RGB composite by right-clicking on the product name in the Product Explorer and selecting 'Open RGB Image Window'. In the RGB channel dialog, assign: Red channel = band_2 (NIR), Green channel = band_3 (Red), Blue channel = band_4 (Green). Click OK to display the false-color composite image.
